The '''Silent Desert''' was a natural feature of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], so named because of its unique ability to nullify all sound transmitted in its environment.

==Description==
The Silent Desert was a vast wasteland of sand that could absorb all sounds. This phenomenon had been attributed to some inexplicable property of the constantly shifting sands, or even to the great sand sculptures that arose sporadically from the desert, especially at night. Mesmerizing to travelers, these sculptures were thought by some to be [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] or at the very least a component of an ancient [[Species/Legends|species]], a theory that was not universally accepted. Even so, the negation of all sound was likely a result of the sculptures feeding on it for sustenance. In the morning, the landscape could have been morphed significantly by the nocturnal movement of these sculptures. For sentient species wandering this land, the persistent absolute silence could be unsettling, afflicting them with loneliness even in the company of each other. Under the ground were natural caverns whose rocky strata provided insulation from the sound nullification on the surface.<ref name="Into the Void" />

As with other deserts, mirages were to be expected in the Silent Desert, and the winds were fierce and relentless. In the afternoon, the temperature could rise to the degree that the heated sand could melt shoes and a mild breeze could cause blisters. In spite of these harsh conditions, the desert had a rich and diverse ecosystem. [[Silik lizard]]s, whose diet consisted primarily of sand, made their homes in this region, alongside a variety of desert birds, [[Lizard/Legends|lizards]], giant [[mankle]]s, [[pendle]]s, and a thin species of [[shire]].<ref name="Into the Void" /> The caves, canyons, and mesas which split the region were the only sanctuaries of sound in the vast wastes of silence.<ref name="NoP" />

==History==
[[Pre-Republic era|In the times]] before the foundation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a large [[Tho Yor]] landed in the desert carrying passengers from distant lands. Around the Tho Yor, these ancient people, known as members of the [[Je'daii Order]], erected a Temple of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] Skills which they named [[Qigong Kesh]].<ref name="DOTJ0" />

The majority of the temple's complex was underground in the vast cave network where sound carried normally and conditioners cooled exhausted travelers. Nevertheless, many lessons were held on the surface as the Je'daii masters took advantage of the silence of the desert to force students to exercise [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
